signature.name: VTask.fold
signature.type: {α : Type u_1} -> {β : Sort u_2} -> (z : β) -> (f : β → α → β → β) -> Ordnode α → β

conventions.statement: The exact nesting of applications of f depends on the internal tree structure of the Ordnode, which may differ between trees representing the same ordered set due to rebalancing; the fold result for non-associative f is therefore shape-dependent and unspecified beyond the per-node recursive contract.
conventions.note: This is an inherent property of folding over a balanced BST whose shape is implementation-defined.

facts.statement: example : VTask.fold 0 (fun l x r => l + x + r) (Ordnode.nil : Ordnode ℕ) = 0 := by decide

provenance.note: authored by eu.anthropic.claude-sonnet-4-6; certified by the v1.2 kernel validation ladder

facts.statement: example : VTask.fold [] (fun l x r => l ++ [x] ++ r) (Ordnode.nil : Ordnode ℕ) = [] := by decide

provenance.note: authored by eu.anthropic.claude-sonnet-4-6; certified by the v1.2 kernel validation ladder

facts.statement: example : VTask.fold 0 (fun l x r => l + x + r) (Ordnode.node 1 Ordnode.nil 5 Ordnode.nil) = 5 := by decide

provenance.note: authored by eu.anthropic.claude-sonnet-4-6; certified by the v1.2 kernel validation ladder

facts.statement: example : VTask.fold 0 (fun l _ r => l + 1 + r) (Ordnode.nil : Ordnode ℕ) = 0 := by decide

facts.statement: ∀ (t : Ordnode ℕ), VTask.fold [] (fun l x r => l ++ [x] ++ r) t = Ordnode.toList t
